page_title: Free Resume Scanner - Generate Candidate Interview Questions

sources.entry: Resume AI Scanner - Assists in assessing candidates by scanning their resumes, extracting relevant information, and generating questions to evaluate their suitability for a position. #free

summary.name: Resume AI Scanner
summary.one_liner: A free online tool from PDF.ai that scans uploaded resumes and generates an overview plus interview questions for assessing candidates.
use_cases: Generating tailored interview questions for a candidate
Getting a quick overview of a candidate's background
Evaluating candidate suitability for a position
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool where a user uploads a resume (PDF, by clicking or dragging and dropping a file) and receives a resume overview. According to the listing, it extracts relevant information from resumes and generates questions to evaluate a candidate's suitability for a position. The page's meta description says no downloads or sign-ups are required. The page text itself is mostly interface and navigation, so details beyond these are not stated.
notable: Generates interview questions tailored to a resume
No downloads or sign-ups required, per the meta description
Accepts PDF uploads via click or drag and drop
Part of the PDF.ai tool suite
caveats: Page text does not describe limits on file size or number of scans
Only PDF uploads are shown on the page
